title: Governors Awards 2026 Red Carpet Photos: Inde Navarrette, Jaafar Jackson, Guitarricadelafuente and More
content:
The red carpet for the Academy’s 2026 Governors Awards is now open.

Inde Navarrette, Jaafar Jackson, Andrew Garfield, Lance Oppenheim and Nathan Fielder are just a few of the Oscar contenders who have arrived for the 17thgala at the Ray Dolby Ballroom in Hollywood.

This year’s program will present honorary Oscars to Glenn Close, Ridley Scott and Disney’s first Black animator Floyd Norman. Scott previously announced that he is unable to make it to Los Angeles to accept the award in person.

Killer Films co-founders Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler will receive the Irving G. Thalberg, making the first female producing team and first independent producers to earn the honor.

The Governors Awards are considered the first for the year’s Oscar contenders, allowing nominee hopefuls to shake hands and schmooze with hundreds of voting members of the Academy.

The evening is produced by Jennifer Todd and presented in partnership with Rolex.

title_zh: 2026年州長獎紅毯照片：印德·納瓦雷特(Inde Navarrette)、賈法·傑克森(Jaafar Jackson)、吉他里卡德拉豐特(Guitarricadelafuente)等人
content_zh:
2026年奧斯卡金像獎的州長獎紅地毯現在已經開放。

印德·納瓦雷特(Inde Navarrette)、賈法·傑克森(Jaafar Jackson)、安德魯·加菲爾德(Andrew Garfield)、蘭斯·奧本海姆(Lance Oppenheim)和內森·菲爾德(Nathan Fielder)等奧斯卡提名者已經抵達好萊塢的雷·多比宴會廳參加第17屆盛會。

今年的頒獎典禮將向格倫·克洛斯(Glenn Close)、雷德利·史考特(Ridley Scott)和迪士尼首位黑人動畫師弗洛伊德·諾曼(Floyd Norman)頒發榮譽奧斯卡。史考特之前已宣布他無法親自前往洛杉磯接受獎項。

Killer Films的共同創辦人克里斯汀·瓦喬恩(Christine Vachon)和帕梅拉·科夫勒(Pamela Koffler)將獲得歐文·G·塔爾伯格獎，成為首個女性製作團隊和首個獨立製作人獲得此榮譽。

州長獎被視為今年奧斯卡提名者的首次亮相，讓提名希望者能與數百位奧斯卡投票成員握手交流。

當晚的活動由珍妮弗·托德(Jennifer Todd)製作，並與勞力士(Rolex)合作呈現。
